name: Lurdusaurus
sum: A massive, unusually shaped iguanodont from the Early Cretaceous Elrhaz Formation of Niger, whose name means "heavy lizard".
wsnote: Not given in the sources used.
holotype: Not read in the sources consulted; described by Taquet and Russell in 1999 from Niger.
material: Not read in the sources consulted.
biology: Its body plan is highly atypical for an iguanodont.
author: Taquet and Russell 1999
